item.name: Attempts, ExamPassed notification and player progress
item.description: Game Service flow through the Gateway. Needs the seeded stack and runs after the CRUD requests above. Each run creates its own exam, so it can be repeated. A pass notifies World Service (POST /events/exam-passed); until World Service implements it, or when no World Service instance is registered in Service Discovery, the submit response carries unlockPending: true, which this collection accepts.

exec: // Mint a service token the Gateway accepts: HS256, issuer player-service, audience kahoots-with-the-undead, kind service.
// The Gateway forwards its subject as X-Service-Name, which the service-only endpoints require.
const payload = encode({ sub: 'game-service', kind: 'service', iss: 'player-service', aud: 'kahoots-with-the-undead', iat: now, exp: now + 3600 });

request.description: Mints the service token used by the requests below that only a service (Game Service) may call. Uses the collection variable jwtSecret, which must equal the Gateway's JWT_SECRET (the team compose development secret by default).

item.name: Saga Participant (v5.0.0)
item.description: Tests Exam Service Saga participant endpoints (/exams/sagas/*) orchestrated by Message Broker: access rules, reserve-achievement, release-achievement (including tombstones and late reserve rejection), confirm-achievement, and GET /exams/sagas/:sagaId.

request.description: Verifies the v5.0.0 sagas health block via the Message Broker queue.

Verifies that missing X-Saga-Id / X-Saga-Step headers return 400 validation_failed.
